Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Crime | Regional 80-year-old woman rescued after alleged ritual attempt to behead her in Ashanti Region Source : Josephine Obeng 17 November 2026 2:54pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
An 80-year-old woman has been rescued by residents after unknown assailants attacked her at Nyankyerenease in the Kwadaso Municipality of the Ashanti Region.
Residents alleged that the assailants attempted to behead the aged woman for ritual purposes.
The victim, who is yet to be identified, was reportedly attacked in her room on Monday, November 16, 2026.
A resident, who spoke to Adom News, said the woman was found seriously injured with her neck slit open and lying in her room on the day of the incident.
"We woke up in the morning only to see the woman seriously injured in her room," the resident said.
According to residents, the suspects fled after the attack, leaving the woman in a critical condition.
The aged woman has since been rushed to the Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital for surgery and other critical medical care.
Police in the area have also been notified to investigate the matter, as residents appeal to the security agency to intensify patrols in the area to protect lives, especially the elderly.
